name_en: Tai Somen — a whole simmered sea bream served over noodles for weddings and milestones
summary_ja: タイを一尾丸ごと煮て、ゆでた素麺と大皿に盛り、煮汁をかけ汁にして食べる。素麺は七夕の織女に、タイは縁起物にちなむとされ、婚礼や還暦など祝いの席で親族に振る舞われてきたという。
summary_en: A whole sea bream is simmered and set on a large platter of boiled somen noodles, the cooking broth doubling as a dipping sauce. The noodles are linked to the Tanabata weaver-star legend and the fish to good fortune, and the dish has long been served to family at weddings and milestone birthdays.
source_title: 鯛そうめん 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
